title: Nitocris of Babylon
summary: Raleigh names Nitocris of Babylon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Nitocris, a famous Queene of Babylon in Herodotus, whom Raleigh takes for the sister of Euilmerodach if Nitocris were his sister, more cunning than Semiramis. She is not the Egyptian queen of the sixth dynastie. The one-word title would fold onto nitocris, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
